earnings.title: DuPont Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Net Sales of $1.9 billion increased 4%; organic sales increased 5% versus year-ago period
GAAP EPS from continuing operations of $1.24; adjusted EPS of $2.09
Cash provided by operating activities from continuing operations of $410 million; transaction-adjusted free cash flow of $341 million representing 121% conversion
Completed $250 million accelerated share purchase and substantially completed $100 million of open market share repurchases in the third quarter

quotes.text: We delivered another quarter of consistent, high-quality performance, once again exceeding our financial guidance.
quotes.by: Lori Koch, DuPont Chief Executive Officer

quotes.text: Our results once again exceeded our financial expectations, demonstrating the strength of our operating model and consistent execution across the businesses.
quotes.by: Antonella Franzen, DuPont Chief Financial Officer

The separation and combination of DuPont’s Nutrition & Biosciences business with IFF could result in a significant tax liability to DuPont.
DuPont is subject to continuing contingent tax-related liabilities of Dow and Corteva following the DWDP Distributions.

On January 22, 2021, DuPont, Corteva, EIDP and Chemours entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (the “MOU”), setting forth a cost sharing arrangement related to future eligible PFAS costs. The Company’s results of operations could be adversely affected by litigation and other commitments and contingencies, including expected performance under and impact of the cost sharing arrangement.

If the Corteva Distribution or the Dow Distribution, in each case, together with certain related transactions, were to fail to qualify for non-recognition treatment for U.S. federal income tax purposes, then the Company could be subject to significant tax and indemnification liability.
